name: Papra
description: A simple document archive for your receipts, bills and papers

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Papra's database, your uploaded documents and the auth secret. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Papra web app and API, published on host as 6890

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: APP_BASE_URL
variables.description: The address you open Papra at. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP address, like http://192.168.1.20:6890, or sign-in fails. Behind a reverse proxy, use your https address.

variables.name: AUTH_IS_REGISTRATION_ENABLED
variables.description: true lets anyone who can open Papra make an account. Make your own account first, then set false.
